const build = (input: { id: string; name: string }): string => input.id + input.name;

export function make(id: string): string {
  const name = 'a';
  build({
    id,
    name,
  });
  return build({
    id,
    name,
  });
}

export function makeAgain(id: string): string {
  build({
    id,
    name: 'b',
  });

  return id;
}
